message: <a href> is focusable inside aria-hidden="true" (at 1:1): keyboard users reach it, screen readers don’t. Remove aria-hidden, or make it unfocusable (tabindex="-1", disabled, or inert).
<button> is focusable inside aria-hidden="true" (at 1:1): keyboard users reach it, screen readers don’t. Remove aria-hidden, or make it unfocusable (tabindex="-1", disabled, or inert).
<button> has aria-hidden="true" but is focusable: keyboard users reach it, screen readers don’t. Remove aria-hidden, or make it unfocusable.
